title: Make subprocess exit handling explicit
why: subprocess.run defaults to ignoring non-zero exit codes, so a discarded result can silently hide command failure.
suggestion: Pass check=true when failure should propagate, or check=false when ignoring the exit status is intentional.
limitations: Only discarded direct subprocess.run calls without check or chained check_returncode are reported.
Aliases, wrappers, and exit-code handling performed by surrounding decorators are not inferred.
